title: Mkpọtụ n'Ifufe
intro: Chee echiche banyere alaeze ebe ihe a na-anaghị ahụ anya na ihe a na-ahụ anya jikọtara ọnụ, ị ga-eguzokwa n'ihu onye dị n'obi alaeze dị iche na nke ọ bụla ọzọ. Mkpụrụ obi a nwere ihe ọmụma karịrị ike nkịtị, na-achịkwa ike ndị ọzọ nwere ike iche n'echiche. Ma, ọbụna ndị kacha ike nwere ike iweda onwe ha ala site na obere ihe e kere eke, eziokwu ahụ nwekwara ike ịnọ na-ezobe ruo oge a kara aka. Ònye bụ onye a nketa ya na-ada ụda kemgbe ọtụtụ afọ?
clues: E nyere m alaeze nke onye ọ bụla ga-esochi m agaghị enwe.
E ketara m ihe ọmụma na amamihe n'aka nne ma ọ bụ nna m hụrụ n'anya.
Ifufe ahụ nọ n'okpuru m, na-aga ebe ọ bụla m chọrọ.
Enwere m ike ịghọta okwu nnụnụ, ha wee jee ozi n'òtù ndị agha m.
Enwetara m ozi sitere n'aka obere nnụnụ gbasara eze nwanyị nke na-efe anyanwụ.
Ọnwụ m nọgidere na-ezobe ruo mgbe anụ ọhịa nke ụwa risịrị mkpara m, ọ bụ mgbe ahụ ka ndị mmụọ ọjọọ ahụ ghọtara na ha amaghị ihe a na-ahụghị anya.

outcome.answer: E zochiri ọnwụ ya nye jinn ruo mgbe e richara mkpara ya

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
